claim: Hybrid retrieval achieves recall@10 of 0.80, MRR of 0.63, and median latency of 182 ms.
BM25 achieves recall@10 of 0.69, MRR of 0.52, and median latency of 74 ms.
Improvement is concentrated in semantic, multi-hop, and temporal questions.
BM25 retains an advantage for exact identifiers and highly specific strings.
Results show that no retriever should be treated as a perfect detector of absence.
